exclusion_reason: No guest execution runtime exists yet, so a containment policy has nothing to confine and no escape attempt has been measured.
promotion_trigger: Promote when guest code stays confined to WebAssembly memory, a content-security policy without arbitrary host script, the package OPFS sandbox, and the mediated relay, and every escape attempt is refused.
expected_failing_assertion: The containment suite cannot refuse a guest attempt to reach host script, storage outside its sandbox, or unmediated network.
active_gate_evidence: The product records the required guest containment policy as evidence and executes no guest code outside a confined boundary.
procedure: Run a guest fixture that attempts host script, out-of-sandbox storage, and unmediated network access.
Confirm each attempt is refused while an in-policy guest continues.
pass_criterion: Every out-of-policy host, storage, and network attempt is refused.
An in-policy guest executes without reaching a host capability.
